tenderSchedule.description: Supply of ACSR RABBIT CONDUCTOR required for CESC jurisdiction
tenderSchedule.locationName: CESCOM Superintending Engineer Procurement Corporate Office Mysuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 2.The bidder should have an experience of 3 years in manufacturing and supply of tendered material

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self-attested copies of the Purchase Order & Performance Certificate pertaining to that PO only

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 3.The bidder should have supplied at least 40% of tendered material in any one of the previous three years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) to the ESCOM/KPTCL/Govt. Utilities of State/Electricity boards in India or Central Government undertakings

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- copies of the Purchase Order & Supply Certificate pertaining to that PO

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 10.bidder should have liquid asset or availability of credit facilities of not less than 25% of amount put to tender. This must be supported by credit lines, letter of credit or certificate from banks for meeting the fund requirement. The bank certificate in the prescribed format shall be as on date of notification of tender or at a later date on or before the last date of submission of the bid shall be uploaded.

9.The Annual Turnover of the bidder shall be at least 50% of the amount put to tender in any one of the previous three financial years i.e., (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) and Document to be submitted: Copies of the audited annual accounts and P&L statements certified by a Chartered Accountant with a valid Unique Documents Identification No (UDIN) shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 4.The Bidder should furnish performance certificate issued by any ESCOMs/Govt Electrical Utilities either for the supplies made directly to ESCOMs/KPTCL for having successful commercial operation for at least one year as on the date of bid submission for 25% of the tendered quantity of the Rabbit ACSR

1.The Bidder should have been registered with the Director of Industries & Commerce, Govt. of Karnataka as a Micro & Small Enterprises (MSE) under Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (Central Act 27 of 2006) for Manufacture of ACSR Conductor

5.The bidder shall furnish the type test certificates for having conducted all the type tests mentioned in the relevant IS/technical specification on ACSR RABBIT Conductor from M/s CPRI/ERDA & such tests reports shall not be older than Five years from the date of bid opening. The type test reports from other than M/s. CPRI/ERDA shall not be considered and such bids will be treated as Non-Responsive

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Type test certificate from M/s CPRI/ERDA

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 6. The bidder must not have been terminated, defaulted, black listed in ESCOMs/DISCOMs or any other Govt. utilities/Organizations as on the date of bid opening. Document to be submitted: The bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 500 value
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: not have been terminated, defaulted, black listed

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 500 value

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 7.The bidder should have valid Bureau of Indian Standard Certification during the preceding 3 years. ocument to be submitted: BIS certificate valid from preceding 3 years shall be uploaded
8.The bidder shall upload GTPs, failing which the bid document is liable for rejection

11.Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority. (As per Government Order No. FD 455 Exp-12/2020 dated 25.08.2020.) Scanned copy of Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded regarding Boarder sharing or not

12. A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted, uploaded by the Bidder separately in the following format: I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India. I certify that this Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder fulfils all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered
